findings.claim: The new Claude settings wire Stop/SessionEnd/PreCompact to `.claude/hooks/dist/karpathy-flush.mjs`, but this diff does not add that compiled entrypoint, so the configured hook will fail at runtime in a clean checkout of this change.
findings.evidence: The settings hunk invokes `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/dist/karpathy-flush.mjs` for Stop, SessionEnd, and PreCompact, while the diff only adds `.claude/hooks/src/karpathy-flush.mts` and no corresponding `.claude/hooks/dist/karpathy-flush.mjs` file.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the compiled `.claude/hooks/dist/karpathy-flush.mjs` artifact or change the settings to invoke an entrypoint that exists in the repository.

findings.claim: The newly added hook test suite imports `../dist/lib/paths.mjs`, but this diff does not add either `dist/lib/paths.mjs` or its source, so `npm --prefix .claude/hooks test` will fail if that file is not already present.
findings.evidence: The test hunk imports `toPosix, rel, projectDir` from `../dist/lib/paths.mjs`; the diff adds `dist/lib/flush.mjs`, `dist/lib/hook-io.mjs`, `dist/lib/scan.mjs`, and `dist/scan-prometheus.mjs`, but no `dist/lib/paths.mjs`.
findings.suggested_fix: Include the missing `paths` implementation in both `src/lib/paths.mts` and compiled `dist/lib/paths.mjs`, or remove/update the tests to reference an existing module.

findings.claim: The smoke evidence does not demonstrate the required five-line fixture session-summary generation because it states no files were written and does not show a five-line fixture or generated summary artifact.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2.1 requires: `Give fhir-knowledge-curator a fixture ledger of five lines; verify it produces a session summary with no prompt/tool content and runs npm --prefix .claude/hooks run scan:prometheus with exit 0`; the evidence file reports `No files written. Fixture analysis complete.` and only includes aggregate metrics plus the scan result.
findings.suggested_fix: Add evidence showing the five input ledger lines and the generated metadata-only session summary, or adjust the smoke artifact to include the summary output while still excluding prompt/tool content.
